existing.description: The Beca al Talento Académico Internacional is the Tecnológico de Monterrey scholarship for international applicants, reserved for candidates coming from secondary schools in a named group of Latin American and Caribbean countries. It recognises students with an outstanding academic record and can award support of between 40% and 60% of the tuition cost, valid for the campus to which the applicant has been admitted. The call is published once a year for new entrants to the August–December semester, requires a minimum average of 90/100 in bachillerato or high school study, and is limited to candidates under 21 years of age at the time of application. Applicants must be admitted to a professional programme starting in August 2027 and must present the Prueba de Aptitud Académica with a minimum score of 1,360 points, or an equivalent SAT or ACT score converted to that scale.
eligibility: Be applying from an institution in one of the listed countries: El Salvador, Colombia, Bolivia, Nicaragua, Peru, Costa Rica, Panama, Dominican Republic, Brazil, Argentina, Chile, Venezuela, Honduras, Ecuador, Guatemala, Paraguay, Uruguay, Cuba, Trinidad and Tobago, Puerto Rico or Haiti
Be in the last year of bachillerato or high school, or have already completed those studies
Be under 21 years of age at the time of application

Have an average of at least 90/100 over the complete or accumulated grades of the first two years of bachillerato or high school study, in the case of three-year programmes, or the equivalent for other study modalities
Have been admitted to begin a professional programme or career at the Tecnológico de Monterrey in August 2027
Present the Prueba de Aptitud Académica and obtain a minimum score of 1,360 points, with up to two attempts allowed
Apply within the official dates of the call
existing.eligibility_summary: Candidates in their final year of, or who have completed, bachillerato or high school study in a named Latin American or Caribbean country, who are under 21 at the time of application, hold an average of at least 90/100, have been admitted to a professional programme at the Tecnológico de Monterrey starting in August 2027, and score at least 1,360 on the PAA or the equivalent converted SAT or ACT.
benefits: Between 40% and 60% of tuition cost, valid for the admitted campus
Option of a socioeconomic complement of up to 30% additional support, capped at 80% in total
Recognition as an academic talent award in the university's international scholarships portfolio
coverage: Tuition support of between 40% and 60% of the tuition cost (colegiatura), valid for the campus to which the applicant was admitted
Possible complement of up to a further 30% through the Beca Socioeconómica, without exceeding 80% total support, subject to evaluation by the Scholarships Committee
requirements: Sit the Prueba de Aptitud Académica and reach at least 1,360 points, or an equivalent SAT or ACT score converted to that scale
Upload an official copy of the graded transcripts issued by the relevant authority
Submit the scholarship application through the admission application on solicitud.tec.mx, in the Becas y Apoyos Educativos section
Pay the place reservation (Reserva de lugar al Tec) by February 25, 2027, since failure to do so cancels the award
Meet the conservation requirements in each academic period to keep the support
documents: Official copy of the bachillerato or high school transcript
Prueba de Aptitud Académica result of at least 1,360 points, or the converted SAT or ACT equivalent
Completed scholarship application within the admission application
application_method: Register and start, or use an existing, Solicitud de Admisión at solicitud.tec.mx
Schedule and sit the Prueba de Aptitud Académica at the relevant campus
Confirm that the published eligibility requirements are met
From August 24, 2026, open the Becas y Apoyos Educativos section, run the profile evaluation and select the scholarship option
Submit the application on a single date and only for the campus to which admission was granted
existing.selection_notes: Winners are selected from among applicants who meet the published requirements, using the PAA score and the average of previous studies as the basis, with ties decided by the holistic evaluation of the Admissions office. The number of awards is limited, the Tecnológico de Monterrey reserves the right to declare the award deserted, and the evaluation and allocation decision is final and non-appealable with no feedback process after results are published. Matters not foreseen in the call are resolved by the Scholarships Committee.
existing.best_fit: High-achieving students from a listed Latin American or Caribbean country who are under 21, hold an average of at least 90/100, have a strong PAA or converted SAT or ACT score, and have been admitted to a professional programme at the Tecnológico de Monterrey for August 2027.
existing.notes: This is the international variant of the university's academic talent scholarship and is reserved for applicants from the listed countries; it is distinct from the domestic Beca al Talento Académico and from Líderes del Mañana LATAM. Winners must pay the place reservation payment by February 25, 2027 or the scholarship is cancelled. A complement through the Beca Socioeconómica can be requested until March 30, 2027, is exclusive to this award and cannot be combined with other talent awards, and remains subject to evaluation and approval by the Scholarships Committee.
existing.duration: Entrance scholarship for a professional degree beginning in August 2027, subject to annual conservation requirements
existing.application_period: Applications are accepted from August 24, 2026 and the call closes on January 22, 2027. The general admission deadline is January 20, 2027, although some programmes have earlier deadlines of December 10, 2026 or January 13, 2027, and a second PAA sitting may be taken up to January 16, 2027.
existing.deadline_display: January 22, 2027 (Cierre de convocatoria). Applications open from August 24, 2026; admission deadline January 20, 2027; results February 18, 2027
